name: Shrouded Assailant
disable: DC 43 Thievery check (master) to steal the cloth before the spirit manifests, or DC 47 Athletics check to pull the cloth off the spirit after it manifests
reset: The haunt is reset when the mirror is covered again.
routine: (3 actions) The spirit uses 3 actions to Step, fly 60 feet, or Strike, in any order. On a successful Strike the spirit's target is Frightened 1, and on a critical success, the target is Frightened 2.

items.name: Don Shroud
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the area

---

Effect The spirit steps out of the mirror, wearing the cloth as a shroud and revealing the mirror. The triggering creature is Frightened 3 unless they succeed at a DC 38 Will save save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: A spirit steps out of a covered mirror, pulling off and becoming shrouded in the cloth, which reveals the mirror. The shrouded figure attacks the living until the cloth is yanked off, which banishes the formless spirit.
